research_mode: official Ministry of Justice and HMPPS accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Foreign national reception counts
verified_claims: Albanian, Romanian, Polish, Irish, and Indian nationals accounted for just under two-fifths of foreign national first receptions in 2025.
limitations: Counts by nationality must remain aggregate and cannot be used for person or parcel scoring.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Untried admissions
verified_claims: There were 40,515 untried prison admissions in 2025, 3% more than in 2024.
limitations: Admissions are justice-system flows and not direct measures of local crime incidence.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Convicted unsentenced admissions
verified_claims: There were 25,714 convicted unsentenced entries to custody in 2025, 1% more than in 2024.
limitations: The figure cannot be spatially joined to a parcel without event-level geography, which is absent.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Sentenced admissions
verified_claims: There were 47,769 sentenced admissions to prison in 2025, a 2% increase from 2024.
limitations: Sentenced admissions do not identify local safety at an address.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Short-sentence admission share
verified_claims: Sentenced admissions for sentences under 12 months represented 44% of all sentenced admissions in 2025.
limitations: The share is a custody-flow composition measure only.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Immediate custodial admissions
verified_claims: There were 47,742 immediate custodial admissions in 2025, 2% more than in 2024.
limitations: The total is national and cannot be treated as an area risk rate.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Public-order admissions
verified_claims: Immediate custodial admissions for public-order offences increased by 19% between 2024 and 2025.
limitations: The publication notes contextual policy and disorder effects; it does not support parcel attribution.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Annual recall admissions
verified_claims: There were 45,432 recall admissions to custody in 2025, 28% more than in 2024.
limitations: Recall admissions reflect licence administration and policy as well as behaviour, so they are not a local crime proxy.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Long-sentence recall admissions
verified_claims: Recall admissions from determinate sentences of 12 months or more increased by 33% and represented 51% of all recall admissions.
limitations: Sentence-based recall flows cannot establish safety at a location.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Quarterly first receptions
verified_claims: There were 18,379 first receptions into custody between October and December 2025.
limitations: The quarterly national count is not exact-address evidence.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Quarterly reception breakdown
verified_claims: Quarterly first receptions comprised 12,771 remand, 5,502 sentenced, and 106 non-criminal first receptions.
limitations: The breakdown is institutional and cannot be assigned to parcels.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Quarterly receptions change
verified_claims: Total first receptions in October to December 2025 were 2% higher than in the same quarter of 2024.
limitations: The comparison does not identify local drivers.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Quarterly admission types
verified_claims: Untried admissions were 9,699, convicted unsentenced admissions 6,277, and sentenced admissions 12,058 in the latest quarter.
limitations: These categories can overlap broader flows and are not parcel-level incident measures.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Quarterly recall admissions
verified_claims: Recall admissions increased by 36% to 13,310 in October to December 2025 compared with the same quarter in 2024.
limitations: The increase is affected by recall policy and early-release schemes and cannot be used as a local crime score.
